200.description:
Autocomplete for a partial query: search phrases, products (with id and lowest price), shops and category filters, as the site's search box shows them.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string | Always SE: prisjakt.nu is the Swedish market. |
| `currency` | string | Always SEK; every price in this output is in Swedish kronor as the site reports it. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the program read the source. |
| `query` | string |  |
| `suggestions` | object[] |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
